title: Free tutorial: A login bypass with SQL injection
summary: Prove a SQL injection login bypass with one request, on a shop built for practice, and see the fix.

next.title: Seminar 9: Authorised testing: web, APIs and findings that get fixed

script.intro: Welcome. In the next fifteen minutes you will prove one SQL injection with a single request, and then see the one-line fix. This is an authorised test of a practice shop, NimbuMart. Only ever do this with written permission.
script.outro: That is a finding, not a trick: one request, one proof, one fix. In the full Seminar 9 you write the finding up so the developers actually fix it, and you learn the rules of engagement that keep you safe.
steps: Read the setting so you know the company, the date and the time zone. Then open the evidence in the case folder.

The shop's login builds a SQL query by pasting your email straight into it, inside quotes. If you end the quote yourself and add two dashes, the rest of the query becomes a comment and the password check never runs. Open the web proxy, send one login request as the admin, and stop the moment you have proved it. One request is a proof; ten is a risk to the client. Then repeat it in Hack the shop, and open the SQL injection lab to see the fix: a parameterised query, where the database never treats your input as code.

That is a finding, not a trick: one request, one proof, one fix. In the full Seminar 9 you write the finding up so the developers actually fix it, and you learn the rules of engagement that keep you safe.
